Hole-aware exact Extrude, Revolve, translational Sweep, and Loft paths now preserve void topology and validated volume.
Twenty-eight capabilities remain explicitly partial, concentrated in composition-critical modeling and exchange functions.

The complete optimized SwiftCAD facade bundle passes 181/181 tests across 69 suites in 244.344 seconds; public general torus-torus and general cone-torus Boolean paths retain their existing expected volumes and tolerances.
CADExchange passes 237/237 internal fixtures, but STEP/IGES remain partial until independent external interoperability evidence closes their declared domains.
The repository's own release contract reports 0/8 gates and no evidence manifests.
decision: Treat the project as an advanced exact-CAD kernel prototype for constrained Agent workflows, not as a general autonomous complex-product CAD system or production-ready release.
caveat: Do not convert 39/67 into an overall completion percentage; capability dependencies and envelope breadth are not uniform.
